title: Personnel.
bodyText: The department of labor and industrial relations may establish positions and hire necessary personnel for the purposes of this part in accordance with chapter 76.
bodyHtml: §373C‑33  Personnel.  The department of labor and industrial relations may establish positions and hire necessary personnel for the purposes of this part in accordance with chapter 76. [L 1983, c 193, pt of §1; am L 2000, c 253, §150; am L 2006, c 300, §12]
